g.text: the model 90% interval, one segment per sampled evaluation
Model projection vs actual - 1,467 sampled evaluations (1-in-12 of the evaluations with an interval)
The control limit range R, the yardstick, is 9.7 DK points at the median across all evaluations.
Every evaluation is projected and plotted: nothing is dropped. The interval is the engine's own 90% interval.
